title: Code of Ethics
tabs: [{"label":"Conflict of Interest","heading":"Conflict of Interest","body":"Employees must avoid situations where personal interests conflict, or appear to conflict, with the interests of the organisation. This includes financial interests, outside employment, and personal relationships that may influence business decisions."},{"label":"Accepting Gifts","heading":"Accepting and Giving Gifts","body":"Strict guidelines govern the acceptance and giving of gifts, entertainment, and other benefits. Any gift or hospitality must be modest, infrequent, and transparent. Cash or cash-equivalent gifts are never acceptable."},{"label":"Privacy","heading":"Protecting Privacy","body":"We are committed to protecting the personal information of our employees, customers, and partners. Data must be collected, stored, and processed in compliance with applicable privacy laws and our internal data protection policies."},{"label":"Use of Assets","heading":"Proper Use of Assets","body":"Company assets - including equipment, facilities, intellectual property, and funds - must be used responsibly and for legitimate business purposes only. Personal use should be minimal and must never interfere with job performance."},{"label":"Antitrust","heading":"Antitrust and Competition","body":"We compete fairly and ethically in the marketplace. Employees must not engage in price fixing, market allocation, bid rigging, or any other practice that violates competition laws. Contact Legal before any competitor discussions."}]
